name: update-progress-failed-checksum
description: S→C update.progress push (protocol 1.8, SPEC §7, D-10/D-11): the terminal failure shape — stage `failed` always carries `error`, drawn from the closed seven-value vocabulary, and there is NO `pct` key (D-10 gives pct to `downloading` only). `checksum` here means the downloaded sha256 did not match the digest the server resolved for itself, so the file was deleted and the installer was never spawned (D-15). The vocabulary is closed precisely so that no path, URL, HTTP status or exception name can reach the phone through this channel (D-11) — the human-readable rendering is entirely client-side.
